record.title: Milne's rationality conjecture for abelian varieties
record.scope_note: 完整读过该固定提交中 README、主文件、六个正文节、嵌入图和参考文献表；主文件与递归输入闭包全部解析，无附录、无未读正文。README 无编译命令。这里的 full_body_read 仅为正文源码首读；未逐篇核验引用，未运行 Lean，未编译或逐页核对 PDF，不据此认证定理成立。
sections_read: Introduction（主定理、来历、两种输运、四步概要）
Comparisons and rational Lefschetz classes（比较、共同有理空间、推拉、指定代数同态提升）
Transport through Hodge-type integral models（辅助强可容数据、指定可容滤过的实现、共同有理归一化、CM 输运）
An endomorphism-stable weakly admissible filtration（有界次数避零、拉格朗日横截、最大缺陷、斜率分块、有限局部域下降）
Balanced Weil classes（正交/可逆二分、除子多项式系数提取、保持除子的提升）
CM reduction and consequences（幂上的有理幂等元、平衡 Weil 约化、主定理、固定有理 Tate 理论、特殊纤维代数性）
Included figure two-transports and complete bibliography
record.claim_as_stated: 对任意在固定 p-adic 位 w 有好约化的 A/Qbar、任意有理 Hodge 类 gamma∈H^{2r}(A(C),Q(r))，及约化 A0 上任意 d-r 个 Cartier 除子，其特殊化与除子乘积在全部 l≠p 的实现及扩标至 Cw 的 crystalline 实现中，迹均为同一个 q∈Q，含 p=2。进一步，结合另文的 CM Hodge 定理，特殊化由一个共同有理代数 cycle 表示；这一加强不是主有理性定理的输入。
proof_architecture: 先建立共同有理 Lefschetz 空间的完美配对；用一个可逆有理交数矩阵证明 pushforward 系数在各实现相同，从而配对性质对有理 pullback 封闭。
将 Hodge datum 扩张为若干原表示副本上的强可容 Hodge-type datum；在特殊纤维以一个真实 quasi-isogeny 输运所有定义张量。用 ample 除子交数比 lambda∈Q× 把局部 similitude lambda_v 同时归一化，再把原 Hodge 类拉回。
第一种输运选 CM lift；用 CM eigenspace 的所有 Galois 共轭均平衡，把 CM 类拆为幂的有理幂等元因子上平衡 Weil 类的 pullback。
对平衡 Weil 类考察 Rosati 自伴、E-反线性的有理 endomorphism 空间 U：若 U 无可逆元，非零配对会产生一个 eigenspace 上非退化除子并反推出可逆元，故所有配对为零。
若 U 有可逆 u，构造保持 E,u、polarization 的弱可容平衡滤过；有界次数避零保证同时横截所有固定系数域子对象，最大超模缺陷把检验约化到 E,u 稳定对象。局部 Shimura 实现给出第二个辅助 lift，指定 projector、E-action、除子随滤过提升。
在该 lift 的复 Betti 描述中，对 (sum_tau x_tau^2 D_tau)^s 提取纯系数，得到一个有理除子恒等式；在所有实现共同特殊化，再有理 pullback 回原类。附加 CM Hodge 输入给特殊纤维的一个共同代数 cycle。

construction_ideas.idea: 把通用非零 minor 的选择与评价点的选择分离：有界次数同时避零。
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: 固定离散赋值系数域 K1/K0 为有限扩张，r,b≥1；所有禁用多项式属于同一 K1[X0,...,X_{r-1}]，非零、总次数≤b。取 N>b，B=b sum_{i=0}^{r-1}N^i；若 e 为 K1/K0 分歧指数，取素数 q>max(B,e)，theta^q=p，令 Xi=theta^{N^i}。
construction_ideas.mechanism: 不同多重指标以 N 进制映入不同单变量指数，总次数≤b 的非零多项式变为次数≤B 的非零单变量多项式；[K1(theta):K1]=q>B，故共同非零。可同时处理任意基数的固定域约束。
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: 若存活 row-transversal Q(Z) 对应的若干目标 minors 可先证明是统一次数有界的非零形式，可用幂指数隔离得到一个同时保秩的代数参数点；整系数或有理参数版本可再用根界选择整数 t。它启发先证明形式非零、后计高度的分层设计。
construction_ideas.missing_step: 原引理提供的是高次数代数点，不是低高度整数点。要用于 pi 的整数 determinant 矛盾，必须另给 norm/分母清除与高度成本；指数 N^i 可能令 column-cost 失控。若系数域随 theta 扩张则结论不成立。

construction_ideas.idea: 以总缺陷的超模性寻找唯一最大的障碍，避免逐个子对象检验。
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: 子对象格对交与和封闭；f(P)=t_H(P)-t_N(P) 只取有限多个值，Newton 数在短正合列可加，Hodge 交维数满足 f(P)+f(Q)≤f(P∩Q)+f(P+Q)；给定可逆算子保持滤过及 f。
construction_ideas.mechanism: 所有最大值对象在交与和下封闭，因此存在唯一包含全部最大值对象的最大 Pmax；保持 f 的算子必固定 Pmax。只需在算子稳定子对象上排除正缺陷。
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: 在有限行/列支持集合上，若把容量缺陷写为 modular capacity 减 matroid rank，则超模性给一个 canonical 最大坏集合。可尝试用它压缩 signature capacities 的所有 Hall 型障碍，并检验实际 Q(Z) 存活条件是否容许相同闭包。
construction_ideas.missing_step: 当前 row-transversal 家族未必构成对交/并封闭的格；加入二次 occupancy 代价后必须重新证明所用缺陷的超模方向，不能只沿用线性 rank 的直觉。

construction_ideas.idea: 用一个固定有理配对归一化全部局部对象，始终比较同一个对象。
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: 各实现中 a*theta_B=lambda_v theta_*；theta_* 为同一有理 ample 除子，deg(theta_*^D)≠0，a*theta_B 也为有理除子，cycle trace 与有理交数相容。
construction_ideas.mechanism: lambda_v=deg(a*theta_B theta_*^{D-1})/deg(theta_*^D) 为同一个有理 lambda；再由 untwisted tensor 恢复 twisted 类的共同缩放。
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: 整数 determinant 构造若经历基变换、投影、不同范数或不同局部实现，应先固定同一 rational normalization/清分母因子。可用一个非零有理测试功能校准，防止算术下界与解析上界实际作用于不同缩放的 determinants。
construction_ideas.missing_step: 这里只是精确相容性的设计原则；pi 近似问题仍需真实非零 determinant 及定量共同分母估计。

construction_ideas.idea: 用向量值多项式的系数而非单个 eigenspace 的有理下降生成目标空间。
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: E/Q 有限 CM 域；T 为 E-秩 2s 的 rational summand；D=sum_tau D_tau 在每个 eigenspace 非退化；全部 (b*D)^s（b∈E）位于一个共同有理 divisor span。
construction_ideas.mechanism: P(x)=(sum_tau x_tau^2 D_tau)^s 的 x_tau^{2s} 系数为非零 determinant D_tau^s；对 rational points 的 Zariski 稠密性及 faithful scalar extension 给整个有理 pure determinant 空间的包含。
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: 若可把多个近似线性形式编码成有理向量值多项式，可通过系数提取/有限差分隔离一个特定 transversal 或 signature，而不要求每个嵌入/坐标单独有理。
construction_ideas.missing_step: Zariski 稠密只给存在；用于整数 determinants 需显式有限评价集、Vandermonde 分母及评价高度，且不能假定 isolated coefficient 自动没有 cancellation。

limits: 这是一轮完整源码阅读，不是独立正确性审查。Deligne/Blasius 比较、Milne Lefschetz 完美配对、Serre–Tate/Tate 提升、Kisin–Zhou 特殊点与 p=2 条款、Pappas–Rapoport period/uniformization 与 Gleason–Lim–Xu 条件均按文中声明作为外部输入，未逐篇回读核验。
CM 输运及第二次指定滤过输运发生在特殊纤维与增维后的幂上；并无原 generic fiber 到同维 CM variety 的映射，也不推出任意复 abelian variety 的 Hodge conjecture。
主 rationality theorem 与使用 032 得到的 algebraic specialization 必须区分；两个稿件的交叉后果不能被误当作各自主证明的循环输入。
避零、系数提取与最大障碍工具不直接给 pi 的 BA 或 nonBA，尤其没有可用的最终 integer determinant 高度/解析指数。

title: The rational Hodge conjecture for CM abelian varieties

record.title: The rational Hodge conjecture for CM abelian varieties
record.scope_note: 完整读过 README、主文件、preamble、主文件列入的十个正文 TeX（含所有后果）、完整 references.bib；递归 include 闭包已解决，无附录。04-theta 全部 1064 行分三块读完；其余 body 均逐行输出读过，无正文截断。README 无编译命令。full_body_read 仅为源码首读，不代表 cited results、Lean 或整条证明已独立认证。
sections_read: Introduction
CM tensors and four-factor relations（scalar descent、degree-one realization、rank-one CM structures、two-row switches、nonzero contractions）
A surface criterion for the switch（非零 functional 经四个 divisor kernels 变为精确 line vector）
Theta differentials and a nonzero mixed period（sign/ball、positive Lagrangian、theta covariance、unitary splittings、cotangent spanning、rank-two projection、fixed-input variation）
Projective ball quotients and a Frobenius identity（full tuple moduli、good ordinary primes、algebraic Hecke action）
A Frobenius polynomial from ordinary neighbors（全部 branch multiplicities 与 integral Albanese identity）
CM sources of the theta one-forms / active spherical parameter（inverse Hecke action、radial scalar relation、Satake triple、central finite order）
From Frobenius slopes to Hodge types / Rational CM sources（filtration-preserving generalized projectors、weight selection、all scalar conjugates）
Completion of the CM proof
Generalized Hodge and arithmetic consequences（effective realization、generalized Hodge、Tate、Hodge standard、specialization）
Complete preamble and bibliography
record.claim_as_stated: 对每个复 CM abelian variety 及每个 codimension p，CH^p(A)_Q→H^{2p}(A,Q)∩H^{p,p}(A) 满射；包括任意有限积和幂。文中另以此导出 CM varieties 的 generalized Hodge conjecture，以及通过 Milne 定理导出所有有限域 abelian varieties 的 Tate conjecture、任意特征 abelian varieties 的 Hodge standard conjecture。
proof_architecture: 把 rational Hodge 类分成 embedding-line exterior monomials；所有 scalar conjugates 的 balance 给 odd sign functions 的总和关系。相同 column sums 的两张 sign-row 表经逐列 two-row switches 相连，故只需四因子 switch v1+v2=v3+v4 的 algebraicity。

证明 surface criterion：四个 prescribed degree-one CM sources 若在一张 smooth projective surface 上有非零四重 period，则 surface pushforward 给非零 functional；四个 all-conjugate (1,1) divisor kernels 将它转换为所需 exact pure tensor，保留非零系数。

在 compact arithmetic complex two-ball quotient 上用 rank-one theta Taylor tensors 构造 spanning holomorphic one-forms；rank-two completed theta tensor 的 double alternation 消去 unmixed terms，保留 wedge。固定 rational total space、finite input 和 quotient，只变 compact-place data，以 rational approximation 将非零 self-pairing 延续为两种 sign-pair 的非零 mixed period。
构造所有分支/连通分量的 projective full-tuple moduli 及 Albanese product；Hecke operators 为代数 endomorphisms。普通点 quotient-neighbor 数数（包括 q 和 q² 重数）给 integral cubic Phi³-D1 Phi²+qD2 Phi-q³D3=0。

计算 theta inputs 的 inverse spherical action，radial dilation 及 bare rational covariance 给 projective Satake 参数 {q^{1/2},q^{-1/2},e}，所有共轭 |e|=1 且 q-adic valuations=−3v(g)/2。有限阶中心关系控制 scalar b；degree-one Weil weight 从 cubic 的三类 roots 中只留下 bq^{1/2}，其 slope 为 0 或 1。

Hecke generalized character projectors 保持 Hodge filtration；对 projector 和 complement 的 weak admissibility 逼出纯 Hodge type。所有 scalar conjugates 的 complete CM types 确定 rational Hodge-map spans；在同一 projective cover 上选非零 mixed-period 项，应用 surface criterion，逐次 contraction 回原 variety，最后下降 rational coefficients。

construction_ideas.idea: 相同 signature/marginal capacities 之间用局部 two-row switches 建立连通性。
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: 两张 p×m 的 ±1 表每列 plus-sign 个数相同；行可扩成 odd sign functions，conjugate columns 取反。每次只交换同一列中两行相反的 entries，并在 conjugate column 交换相反 entries。
construction_ideas.mechanism: 逐列把 (+,−) 与 (−,+) mismatches 配对，每步保总 column sums，得到有限路径；每步只需四-label relation a+b=a'+b'。
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: 对于 surviving transversal Q(Z)，可把同一 signature 的 row assignment 视为固定 marginals 的 fiber。若 admissible assignments 在允许的 swaps 下连通，可由一个 explicit seed determinant 扩展到整个 signature class，或用局部交换说明各 occupancy profile 的最优 column-cost。
construction_ideas.missing_step: 原文是在所有 odd sign functions 的扩大辅助空间中连通；加入禁止边、固定实际行池、rank 约束、quadratic occupancy 后 fiber 可能断开。必须证明每步仍有存活 transversal，并跟踪 determinant 的符号/非零性与高度。

construction_ideas.idea: 使用非零 dual contraction 组合局部证书，保留精确 scalar 与 slot bookkeeping。
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: 中间每个 slot 有 opposite embedding lines beta_i、gamma_i，二者互为非零 conjugate scalar multiples；ample polarization ell_i 使 qi=∫ beta_i∧gamma_i∧ell_i^{s−1}≠0。前后 tensors 是各槽纯张量、且已为 algebraic-coefficient cycle spans。
construction_ideas.mechanism: 在 triple product 上 pullback、cup product、乘 polarization 幂再 pushforward，输出 endpoint pure tensor 乘 (−1)^{p(p−1)/2} product qi；codimension 逐项核对，qi∈Qbar× 可以除掉。
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: 若把 row/column block determinants 的外幂证书作为端点，以一个 nondegenerate rational dual pairing 消去辅助 slots，可像 Cauchy–Binet 那样组合局部 rank 证书。明确乘积 scalar 可帮助避免把非零 functional 误当作非零 determinant vector。
construction_ideas.missing_step: 一般 determinant 展开含多项会 cancellation；原文 pure tensor 与 polarization positivity 很强。迁移时需自行找到 rational dual bases、明确 pairing 非零，并把 division 导致的 denominator/height 计入算术下界。

construction_ideas.idea: 固定总解析对象，在分解之间连续移动以保非零，最后才分解与清分母。
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: 总 rational Hermitian plane W、symplectic representation、finite theta input phi、compact quotient X 全固定；仅 compact-place positive Lagrangians 在固定 sign multiplicities 内变化；theta series 在紧参数邻域及所有需用导数有统一 Gaussian 控制。
construction_ideas.mechanism: rank-two total form Xi(phi;t) 在同一 compact X 上 C∞ 连续；初始 ∫xi∧bar(xi)>0，因此足够接近的 rational endpoint t' 仍有非零 mixed pairing。两端才改 rational adapted coordinates 并有限分解为 wedges，再共用 cover。
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: 对 parameterized matrix/determinant D(t)，先固定总函数与解析上界，找一个确定非零 seed，再以连续性选择 rational perturbation；最后以 explicit denominator 把同一个 D(t') 变为整数 determinant。可用于设计 rank-preserving signature switches。
construction_ideas.missing_step: 连续性无显式 tolerance 或 rational height bound；本稿允许 rational approximation 的分母任意大，这在 pi 的算术-解析指数竞争中不能忽略。需要定量 lower margin |D(t0)|、Lipschitz bound 和低高度逼近。

construction_ideas.idea: 极端 slope 能推纯类型，前提是 projection 同时保持第二种结构。
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: weakly admissible filtered Frobenius module 的 Hodge indices 仅 0,1；idempotent p 与 Frobenius 可交换且保持 filtration，1−p 也如此；p-image 的所有 slopes 同为 t∈{0,1}。
construction_ideas.mechanism: p 与 complement 分裂总对象，二者均 tH≤tN，而总和相等，故各自相等；于是 dim F1 为0或全维。原文给不保 filtration 的 slope projector 反例，说明不能仅凭 spectrum 作结论。
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: 在 analytic smallness 与 arithmetic rank 比较中，若用 spectral projector/column block 缩减矩阵，需证明它也保整数格或有理分母结构。可把‘同时保持两种结构的 projector’列为 rank reduction 的必要核对项。
construction_ideas.missing_step: 这不是关于整数 minors 的直接定理；保持 rational subspace 不等于低分母，必须另有 lattice-index 控制。

limits: 完整首读不等于论文/证明或 Lean formalization 已核验。未回读 Weil rational covariance、Kudla/unitary splitting、strong approximation、p-adic comparison、Weil weight、Milne 后果等所有外部文献。

复杂的一致性节点（theta Taylor target 的正负/对偶、bare metaplectic 与 circle splitting、inverse Hecke normalization、q-power Frobenius convention、generic-neighbor multiplicities、fixed quotient 与 fixed finite input）均已在源码中读到其论证；这里只记录作者的论证架构，不把它们宣告为通过独立 audit。
two-row switch reduction 使用辅助 CM factors 与 nonzero contractions；它没有声称固定原 variety 的 Hodge ring 由 codimension≤2 classes 在 cup product 下生成。
continuous rational approximation 不给高度；scalar descent 也只给 rational span 的存在。因此这些构造不能直接给 pi 的 BA/nonBA，也未消除当前 same-determinant nonvanishing 与 column/occupancy 成本难点。
同 001 的交叉特殊化后果被明确置于各自主证明之后；没有借该交叉后果作为本稿主定理输入。

title: Removable Boundaries and Rigidity of Circle Domains

record.title: Removable Boundaries and Rigidity of Circle Domains
record.scope_note: 完整读过 README、main、companion-reference 宏、七个正文节、嵌入 line-payment 图及完整 bibliography；递归 include 审计无 unresolved includes，无附录。README 无编译命令。伴随 Koebe 稿件是被引用的外部定量输入，并非本稿未解析 TeX include；未据此声称其全文也已读。full_body_read 为本稿源码首读，未独立验证外部输入、未编译/逐页检查 PDF。
sections_read: Introduction（精确 rigidity 主张及其与 existence 的区别）
Contours, ends, and normalization（component quotient、closed graph/collapse、normal family、removable⇒area zero）
Models retaining finitely many scalar tests（伴随 retained-test 输入、补洞 jump bounds、弱极限精确 trace、smoothing）

record.claim_as_stated: 若 Omega 为 Riemann sphere 的 circle domain，boundary conformally removable，则任意到另一 circle domain 的 conformal equivalence f 均为一个 Möbius transformation 的限制；补集分量可任意基数，f 的 boundary extension 不是假设。本文只证明 removability→rigidity 方向，并非本稿本身同时证明一般 circle-domain existence 或 He–Schramm 原双向断言。
proof_architecture: 以 Moore component quotient 与有限 smooth contour cores 建立任意连通度的 complementary-component correspondence 和 upper semicontinuous closed-graph relation；对源 totally disconnected dust，得到目标 sphere 上连续 inverse collapse。

引用伴随稿 scalar retained-test theorem：给 pairwise trace images area zero 的有限 tests，在同一 exhaustion 上精确保 core、tail Dirichlet energy 与 holes oscillation 平方和趋零；补 round holes 后控制 distributional jump，在弱极限中以 contours 确认所有 omitted components（含 positive-area point dust）的精确 values。
在保留 tests 的 models 中近极大化 Laurent coefficient 的实部；以 conductivity k=n on omitted set 的 Beltrami deformation 得 height v，能量误差≤2pi d。level-set/coarea 证明新坐标与旧 tests 的 pair-null compatibility。

小扰动旧 tests，flatten 非点 hole 的可数 values，priority interpolation 加水平坐标，得到围绕每个 end 的小能量 barriers。逐步保留每个 finite-stage barrier 的严格 margins；极限若有非点分量，其某轴投影包含固定 J，ACL+Cauchy–Schwarz 迫能量≥|J|/(2L)，与 arbitrarily small saved energy 矛盾。故 limit extends homeomorphically，removability 令其为 identity，推出 continuous finite-energy scalar 的 Sobolev extension。
对一般 circle-domain equivalence，mask 所有 source 或 target 为 disk 的可数对应对；ball-synthesis 的 l2 密度控制允许重叠。剩下 common-point dust 应用 scalar theorem，再对典型轴线压缩 tails，得到 common-point projected trace 长度零。
轴线 slice estimates 与 tail multiplicity 至多二次计数给 flux 下界；两侧 area 上界相加后化为 ∫(|f'|−1)^2+pi sum(rj−sj)^2≤0。非负性逼 |f'|=1，再由 holomorphy/normalization 推 Möbius。

construction_ideas.idea: 有限阶段保留严格 margin，新增约束时不破坏先前非零证书。
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: 每个 stage 只有有限 tests；旧坐标可在 uniform norm 与 gradient L2 norm 中任意小改变；每个 saved barrier 具有 exact 1/0 plateau 的正距离 margins 及 strict energy slack。对 smooth Phi，误差由 M1||grad(A'−A)||2+M2||A'−A||∞||grad A||2 控制。
construction_ideas.mechanism: 为第 k 证书选 tolerance tk>0，后续第 n 阶段误差≤2^{-n-3}min(1,epsilon,t1,...,t_{n−1})/sqrt2，故所有旧证书在后续有限阶段持续成立；只需有限-list models，不假设无限-list model。

sections_read: Introduction, including historical context and both functional and entropy–transport corollaries
Polarity, norm sums, Hanner recursion and volume products

record.claim_as_stated: For every origin-symmetric convex body K in R^n, |K||K°|≥4^n/n!, with equality exactly for invertible linear images of Hanner polytopes. The introduction also derives the even functional Mahler and symmetric entropy–transport inequalities from the claimed all-dimensional geometric result.
proof_architecture: Construct a convex conformal lens whose uniform boundary angle gives an independent uniform sign and a uniform imaginary coordinate; establish strict curvature and λ(1−η)∼(2/π)η log(1/η).

Use Stokes around an isolated homogeneous holomorphic zero to lower-bound total squared Jacobian-minor mass, then apply it to high powers of inverse-lens coordinate maps. Rescaled radial variables yield Σ_I P_I≥1 over independent row bases.

Convert each boundary feasibility probability into a real integral with factor |det B_I|/4^d. Extra ties are null, and unique maximizers make feasible signed simplices disjoint in interior, giving 1≤d!4^(−d)∫|Σ_X|≤d!4^(−d)|A||A°|. Approximate arbitrary symmetric bodies.

For equality lift by one segment, approximate the polar product by inner polytopes, and turn vanishing integrated missing volume into nearby feasible point–direction pairs using positive-volume product neighborhoods. Compactness gives one common feasibility witness even for degenerate limiting row representations.

Compare all positive representations using that common witness. Let the point approach the lifted apex; the endpoint ratio of λ yields support inequalities and a median for each triple in the polar norm.

Convert medians to the three-ball intersection property and invoke Hansen–Lima's finite-dimensional classification. Polarity and norm-sum formulas identify precisely the linear Hanner equality bodies.

construction_ideas.idea: A global minor-mass budget can locate a nonzero feasible basis before optimizing its cost.
assumptions: The candidate row family spans the intended determinant dimension, over the field relevant to the integer determinant.
A holomorphic constraint construction can be made whose minor factors are the same candidate determinants and whose compact sublevels and isolated zero are proved.

Test a cost filtration by column degree/denominator size and seek a mass inequality concentrated below the analytic smallness threshold. This could separate proving some minor nonzero from charging its columns, but the existing lemma alone gives no cheap basis and cannot repair deficient rank.

construction_ideas.idea: A single dual feasibility witness can certify all competing row costs, including singular limits.
assumptions: The proposed determinant/column costs admit a convex positive-representation or matroid base formulation.
The same chosen witness is valid for every candidate constraint; competitors cannot each choose a different witness.
Any zero-deficit-to-pointwise upgrade uses positive-volume neighborhoods and actual compactness, rather than assuming pointwise convergence.

Find a dual vector Y giving c_i·Y=cost_i on selected rows and h·Y≤cost_h on every candidate. Then every competing representation has cost at least ξ·Y. record.claim_as_stated: For each fixed ε,δ∈(0,1/2), a deterministic polynomial-time reduction from 3SAT to explicit unweighted simple bipartite Unique Games over a fixed K=F_2^s has completeness≥1−ε and soundness≤δ; every edge is a translation constraint. This is a manuscript claim, not independently validated.
proof_architecture: Construct latent additive noise using characteristic-two quadratic finite-field blocks. Uniform genericity over every linear extension map and random orientations permit adaptive restrictions; the harmonic potential H_r retains positive rank while nonlinear change decays. Quotient shift kernels and add injection-indexed copies to realize any sufficiently large fixed output alphabet.

Preprocess a weighted nearly satisfiable parity gap to three distinct variable IDs per occurrence. Form affine table keys that retain support, actual-bit coordinates and exact intercepts; identify keys through projection and fold free constant translations. The resulting rank-one equality test has near completeness from global assignment evaluation.

Fourier comparison turns high latent-test acceptance into ordinary shortcode acceptance. Grassmann expansion yields a bounded row/column slice. Erase all good row fibers and apply concentration uniformly over every slice–target description to force positive good-advice mass; folding forces a nonempty short set of actual answers.

Compare the full sparse-projection padded table law with unrestricted sampling by a product chi-squared bound: kβ²→0. Transfer the selected witness using a positive probability difference, then a private Fourier decoder reaches the projected short answer set with fixed positive probability. The decoder never receives the other side’s witness.

Choose β=k^(−2/3), so kβ→∞ clean singleton coordinates remain. Condition only on the clean mask, advice intercept and outside data, retaining the independent equation–variable law. Each side reconstructs its original local input; projection-game repetition makes full agreement at most exp(−c k^(1/3)), contradicting the decoded constant lower bound.

Largest-remainder rounding, four-edge subdivision and alphabet-independent repetition give explicit unweighted simple bipartite translation games with prescribed errors. Check quantifier order and polynomial encoding. The appendix supplies simple strong-left games and a rational finite ordering composition using local smoothing, low-influence estimates, influence decoding and conditioning on distinct neighbors.

construction_ideas.idea: Use a harmonic rank potential to compare useful contraction against loss of independence.
assumptions: A concrete family of permitted row/column restrictions has rank drop at most one per step, with conditional loss probability≤c r θ at current rank r.
The rank-loss estimate holds for every extension map that earlier choices can induce; assuming independence from an adaptive construction is insufficient.
The operation improves the analytic determinant size on the same object and preserves its integer structure.
construction_ideas.speculative_interface: In a costed-column determinant construction, track H_r=Σ_{j≤r}1/j instead of raw remaining rank. If collisions among candidate Q(Z) row transversals have probability O(rθ), expected H_r loss is O(θ), permitting many smallness-improving steps while retaining positive rank with explicit probability. A finite simulation should measure rank loss conditioned on signature occupancy, then test whether candidate selection obeys a uniform extension-map bound.

construction_ideas.idea: Prove genericity uniformly over adversarial coefficients using an augmented nonzero minor.
assumptions: The evaluation vectors have algebraic parameter dependence and an algebraic obstruction to column-span membership.
A nonzero polynomial minor is established symbolically before specializing parameters.
Finite-field genericity must be replaced or lifted with explicit integer heights and rational-approximation errors for the actual π problem.
construction_ideas.speculative_interface: The latent proof handles all maps g simultaneously by showing a nonlinear target evaluation vector is outside a matrix column span, then exhibits one augmented minor as a nonzero bounded-degree polynomial. For quadratic occupancy/signature constraints, formulate potential zero terms as target-in-span conditions; prove a formal augmented minor nonzero via monomial/parity support, then specialize integer parameters away from its zero set while costing the specialization. This is a route to certify that structural zero terms do not consume every candidate, rather than counting signatures alone.

construction_ideas.idea: Keep nonlinear stability and linear detection as separately quantified requirements.
assumptions: The two properties are verified under the exact same noise or perturbation law.
Nonlinear error probability and linear detection threshold are fixed before ambient dimension/number of columns grows.
Any lifting to rational approximation controls denominator growth from products and quotients.
construction_ideas.speculative_interface: Treat the analytic smallness of an integral or Padé-type column as the stable nonlinear observable, and determinant rank as detection by a linear family. Search for a perturbation of row choices that changes analytic errors rarely but is detected by any large annihilator/signature space. The manuscript shows that these goals can coexist abstractly; it does not construct such a perturbation for π.

construction_ideas.idea: Use a sparse perturbation regime with many useful coordinates but asymptotically unchanged full law.
assumptions: Independent block contributions have a bounded chi-squared divergence between the ordinary and special-coordinate laws.
The ambient alphabet and all local dimensions are fixed before the number k of blocks grows.
A nonzero determinant or capacity event is transferred using the joint table distribution; agreement of separate marginals is insufficient.

A full-law bound of order kβ² can vanish while kβ diverges, giving many special rows under nearly the same candidate distribution. β=k^(−2/3) balances these requirements. This is directly relevant to quadratic occupancy: a proposed capacity improvement should be checked under the actual joint row law and include the cost of conditioning on distinct/signature-safe selections. proof_mechanisms.mechanism: Zero formal subtrees are upgraded before earlier exponential multipliers are applied.
proof_mechanisms.details: Couple only finitely many selected prefixes through fixed good joins. Correct later rates to absolute o(1) holomorphic proxies by area Cauchy transforms and propagate the next-band growth through the replaced inner wedge. For a zero subtree, first obtain |G(u)|<=C_N exp(-N Z_n(u)) separately for every fixed N. Multiply by exp(H Lhat_n-C Zhat_n); reserve half of every negative source cost, exp(Hx-cU)<=exp(K_H)exp(-cU/2), so the Cauchy-correction norm has an H-independent prefactor. A two-stage maximum principle first proves boundedness using the preliminary real decay, then treats the real ray as interior and removes the arbitrary C_N,u_N. Source-ratio estimates choose H~exp(g)/gprime at bounded slopes, giving Hx_a~V_(n-1); large slopes use a central double-exponential bound followed by a wide-strip harmonic weight. This proves exp(-c V_(n-1)) suppression, which absorbs the finitely many growing exp((a-b)Z_(n-1)) factors when passing earlier zero children. At n=1 there are no sources and H->infinity yields exact zero.

The full coupled functions and earlier joins stay fixed while H and preliminary real orders vary. The common full-forward-domain source envelope is essential.

proof_mechanisms.details: Finite unions, convolution and strict-positive semigroups of iterated left-finite supports give finite coefficient calculations at successive prefixes. Dependent powers are converted exactly into later exponential shifts. Extracted current W_j=e^(-Z_(j,j)) is never frozen at the next background; only later rates are translated. Differentiation preserves strict positivity, while derivative induction plus zero-subtree suppression justifies deleting negative local terms. Positive expressions have bounded ordinary derivatives and exponentially small free derivatives; real local boundedness proves positivity. Regular implicit closure first solves the real equation, then uses bounded real-symmetric tanh interpolation preserving a finite lower jet while attaining each complex trial target. A broad Taylor tube fixes sheet coherence at a stack-dependent order r_d; a separate arbitrarily higher working order N controls residuals. Piecewise Taylor integration across seams gives O(|v|^N), and a real Jacobian contraction constructs unique smooth band roots. Exact implicit equations, rather than differentiation of a pointwise asymptotic statement, supply derivative/seam/source bounds and the actual positive transition series.

record.claim_as_stated: There exists a finite nonempty translational tile T⊂Z^3 admitting tilings but no tiling whose translation set has a finite-index period subgroup. Its unit-cube thickening T+[0,1]^3 tiles R^3 up to null sets but admits no full-rank-lattice-periodic translation set, even with arbitrary real translations.
proof_architecture: Define the two-digit p-adic Sudoku line rule on a strip of width p² (p>200). An exception-free 4×4 square forces a global affine approximation; vertical nonconstancy forces a nonzero row coefficient. Normalize and rescale by p to contradict the smallest positive vertical period. The last-nonzero-p-adic-digit array supplies existence.

Encode each symbol as dependence of an output function on an input digit. The graph equation, dependence equations, and cycle permutation tests encode every forbidden simultaneous activation using one common translation set. Choose pairwise-coprime finite factors so their product is cyclic.

Use shift multiplicity μ=1+ω, with a nonconstant joint distribution but uniform one-coordinate marginals. Exact fibre coverage forces activity; for seeds, the mixed-difference histogram equation gives Q(α,ξ)=u(α)+v(ξ), and nonnegative integer counts contradict a_i∤p⁴ when b_i>p⁴. Extract a nonconstant-column Sudoku array from every common solution.

Construct a single explicit common solution using labelled a_i- and b_i-sized blocks, rotations, and inverse fibre orderings. Two seed regions and one shared cyclic output satisfy both seed tests while activating ordinary symbols from the last-nonzero-digit model.

Stack the simultaneous equations over a fresh prime cyclic coordinate, partitioned into color classes with full difference sets. Unique coverage forces exactly one contribution of every color, so any periodic stacked tiling descends to a periodic common solution.

Lift the cyclic quotient to Z³ using two residue transversals differing by one marked point. A large common difference set forces a hypothetical periodic Euclidean assembly onto a translated grid; marked-cell coverage forces kernel invariance, so descent contradicts the quotient obstruction.

Construct normalized-length algebras C_D,C_E over root towers. Parameter quotients have prescribed positive multiplicity length and positive parameter Koszul homology has length zero. The equal-characteristic construction uses perfection and a trace denominator; mixed characteristic imports precise perfectoid-length results.

Prove rational K-theory descent with closed support for finite surjections with geometrically transitive group actions, including connective associative coefficients. record.claim_as_stated: Every locally compact second-countable Hausdorff group acting faithfully and jointly continuously on a connected Hausdorff second-countable finite-dimensional topological manifold without boundary is a Lie group. The central claimed result excludes faithful continuous Z_p actions for every prime and dimension; every such Z_p action therefore factors through a finite quotient.
proof_architecture: Define T(X) from proper continuous images of constants on compact finite polyhedra, together with shifts, cones, and summands; prove Verdier duality on the actual generated categories using simplex generators. A symmetric interval-cone construction proves homotopy invariance of degree-r Witt groups E_r(X).

Cut off finite source constructions to identify quotient morphisms with germs. Apply integral Witt localization. For a full dense triangulated inclusion, explicitly double a form with a hyperbolic stabilization to build reverse maps whose two composites are multiplication by 2.

Compare semialgebraic and continuous categories on pole covers of spheres using finite exact diagram chases. Obtain a fixed exponent e_j with e₀=0 and e_j=9e_{j−1}+6. A local signature on a ball for each finite relation proves the semialgebraic rational sphere generator is integral, so the continuous rational line has denominator bounded by L_d=2^{e_d}, fixed before the action partition.

Assuming a faithful Z_p action, use Newman's rigidity to find a faithful orientation-preserving action in a chart; stabilize to odd d>n. Average a compactly supported pinch to get a fixed degree-one sphere test through the orbit space. Faithfulness supplies p^k local finite-quotient sheets. Rational orbit pullback plus odd-sphere telescopes move a positive-degree multiple of the test into those sheets.

Partition p-primary characters into m=p^k cyclic classes. Construct their integral Witt classes from α and α(2e_i−1) in a quotient, avoiding splitting quotient idempotents. A matrix congruence proves the sum is 2[A]. Local sheet multipliers make the concentrated classes equal; covariance and homotopy imply the original rational classes are equal after cancelling a nonzero degree scalar.

The original integral classes remain in the fixed lattice and sum rationally to 4u_d, so each equals (4/m)u_d. Choose m>4L_d to force 0<4L_d/m<1 to be an integer. This excludes Z_p; the classical Hilbert–Smith reduction yields the stated Lie-group theorem.

proof_architecture: Define D_q(x,y)=||f(x)−qf(y)||−||x−qy|| and its absolute supremum M. The defect is uniformly 2-Lipschitz in q, bounded by 2min(q,1−q), and changes sign under inversion. If M>0, choose maximizing sequences and pass to an ultrapower and completion so a positive maximum is attained at one 0<t<1 while every pair/radius retains the bound M.

Take opposite radial contacts through ty and tf(y) to define a continuous return map g on directions. Equality at maximal defect forces r=u+M, s=p+M, and a common support for v and g(v). Common-support propagation builds a nonempty invariant closed convex set contained in the maximizing directions.

Show ||g(v)−g(v′)||≤up/(rs)||v−v′|| plus two errors in scalar radii. Since up/(rs)≤(1−M/(1+t))²<1, partition the bounded scalar-radius ranges into finitely many bins to obtain strict contraction of Kuratowski noncompactness. Darbo gives a fixed direction, aligning both extremal chords with p+r=s+u≤2.

For aligned chords define A=p/d,B=u/d,ε=1−t. Weighted signed defects cancel the same target norm and produce a secant K with ε/p≤φ(v)≤K≤1−B or B. If either A or B exceeds ε, support signs and inverse symmetry give a small radial perturbation that makes the defect exceed M.

In the remaining regime A,B≤ε, original and inverse secant bounds imply ε≤dA(1−B), ε≤dB(1−A), and ε<1/2. Convexity gives incompatible bounds on the same preserved distance ||y−z||=||f(y)−f(z)||. Thus M=0.

Zero defect makes the radial map an onto metric isometry. The included Mazur–Ulam midpoint-reflection proof doubles any midpoint error while retaining a uniform bound, forcing additivity and then real homogeneity. The appendix proves the noncompactness lemmas, simplex fixed point via Sperner parity, compact convex fixed point, and Darbo.

proof_architecture: 07: Start from a horizontal zero of the undepleted analytic series b_w^0 and suppose both relevant primitive strict field-test Selmer groups vanish. Choose an algebraic interior point preserving their vanishing and local acyclicity, with safe auxiliary spanning/separation denominators. Two disjoint auxiliary-prime sets and independent exponent vectors ensure one safe set.

07: Build theta sections on canonical ordinary (2,1,1) levels whose depth grows with p-conductor. The text identifies these levels with finite etale flags/frames of the multiplicative character group, proves cusp saturation without depth-dependent precision loss, and calculates both normalized positive p-operators to be 1.

07: Prove a uniform bound for arbitrary bounded locally constant cuts of unary position moments: use compatible upper-triangular cusp changes, coefficientwise group-algebra bounds, squares and saturated integral expansions to remove vertical denominators, then parity projectors and polynomial density. This supplies bounded measures and joint weight limits even for arbitrarily deep cuts.

07: Use Kirillov Fourier inversion at p with a Mellin-one test, and identify upper-unipotent translations with integral-frame Serre–Tate translations. A finite Fourier sum cancels p^{-b} exactly against the orthogonality sum, leaving a bounded unit-restricted measure integral. Toric limits reproduce b_w^0 (up to fixed nonzero scalar/group units) while the companion period remains bounded.

07: Apply bilinear binary Siegel–Weil/Rallis and Waldspurger comparisons with all exceptional raw factors retained. Matrix/toric gamma factors at p cancel including conductors; moving fake Euler and raw additive factors are cleared, fixed Euler factors cancel as rational identities before specialization, and archimedean factorials cancel. The squared cleared identity forces all constant Fourier–Jacobi terms uniformly small. Stagewise choose weight precision first, ordinary weight size next, then increase group depth.

08: Obtain a positive coefficient of bounded valuation at that same nonaugmentation point. One-index unfolding separates a fixed nonzero stabilizer period and two unary periods. Split each moving character into two slot characters, retain integral open-pivot tests, and avoid conductor-dependent averaging.

08: Show the first unary period remains a nonzero analytic function of degree at prescribed t_0 by pushing fixed position measures to the true character group and composing a nonzero measure transform with the nonconstant degree-character map. Restore moving unit cuts as nonzero degree factors, use an ultraproduct-valued analytic limit for varying coefficient fields, and choose degrees/slot parameters where both periods are nonzero. Restore controlled tests using safe finite spanning denominators.

08: Uniform cusp lifting on finite etale canonical branches, Hasse powers and ample twists gives cusp forms without depth-dependent loss. A bounded positive coefficient cancels integral operator relations, producing finite operator orders mapping to O_k/(p^{M_i}) with M_i tending to infinity. The two p-operators retain value 1.

08: Transfer local Galois controls at each classical stage: Hodge–Newton contacts give local ranks 2,3,4 and last quotient/first conjugate line. Inertia- or Frobenius-separated binary projections give inertia-fixed binary allocations; bounded allocation filtrations kill operator nilpotents by a fixed power of a nonzero separation factor, so the congruences descend to reduced eigensystem orders.

08: Form bounded-generator ultraproduct matrix algebras, localize/henselize at the limit map, and retain a faithful reduced ambient realization. The limiting blocks are f=V(-2)chi^{±1}, x=epsilon^{-1}, y=epsilon^{-2}. Lift corner idempotents/matrix units, and use integral contractions of marked finite models to identify admissible cocycles with field-test Selmer classes.

08: Eliminate the cyclotomic y-to-x corner modulo paths through f: local controls make the resulting Kummer class strict at all p-places and unramified elsewhere; the CM biquadratic field has unit rank one and no nonzero global unit with all p-adic logarithms zero. Then a highest-weight argument excludes a globally stable last line at every ambient field evaluation, forcing the y-to-f corner to have zeroth Fitting ideal zero and nonzero residue fiber.

08: A nonzero functional on that corner yields a nonzero extension in V chi^{±1}, strict on the required p-half. Separated binary projections and parahoric rank-one inertia show unramifiedness at each fixed bad place. Shapiro/descent from L to K splits the class between V and its quadratic twist; at least one primitive field test jumps, contradicting the chosen point. This proves the theta implication.

09: At every horizontal DVR factor the strict determinant into fixed singular Euler determinants times the primitive differential determinant. A quotient divisor therefore forces b_w^0 to vanish, hence a primitive jump. This makes each quotient factor horizontal with nonzero reduction modulo (p,t); p-primitivity separately excludes p. Integral Weierstrass division upgrades high-character associations to equality (U_w)=(U_barw).

09: Prove that augmented alternating matrices [A|B] with two extra columns have rank-defect codimension at least two, as does simultaneous defect in two independent even alternating blocks. A tangent-slice kernel inclusion transfers this codimension bound to actual maximal-minor ideals by initial forms in a regular local ring.

09: Add finitely many tame directions at every old quotient divisor. Cup-lift obstruction tests and joint class evaluations span the required independent augmented-alternating or paired-alternating tangent slices. Parity forces one-sided jump dimensions even; two one-sided jumps for one representation lie in the both-strict jump locus. Thus neither both sides for one representation nor one side for both representations can jump together in codimension one.

09: Exact integral specialization in the added directions preserves quotient identities up to units. Any enlarged height-one quotient factor specializes to a nonunit old factor and survives in its localized enlarged ring. Association makes it divide both side quotients; the two theta implications then force one of the excluded simultaneous jump patterns. Hence enlarged and original quotients are units; cancel the same nonzero restored Euler factors and remove artificial variables.

10: At the true-line center compute the strict/full determinant by derived specialization of the full Tate lattice. Begin with Kummer volume 2n_P+2tau_g−s_K, subtract twice the local logarithmic coordinate plus p-torsion, then subtract non-p local torsion twice for split places. Compare its negative valuation with the analytic logarithm expression; exact Haar identities convert surviving local terms into every component number. This yields 2(n_P+tau_g)=s_K+2v_p(c_E)+2sum_q v_p(c_q(E)).

10: Substitute the full group index n_P+tau_g into the earlier discrepancy identity to get X(E)+X(E^D)=0. For non-CM curves both terms are nonnegative by the single-curve inequality. For CM rank zero use the stated Burungale–Flach input after a Galois-stable lattice isogeny to maximal-order CM and descent from the CM field; CM rank one pairs with a rank-zero twist. Thus every odd valuation is exact. Finally the companion converse supplies rank and whole-Sha finiteness, and the two-primary companion supplies positive rationality and the 2-valuation; equality at all prime valuations gives the real exact formula.

R_k 的 codimension 给整个 wedge^kT 的 coniveau≥k−1；(1,1) theorem 使 exterior Hodge classes 代数。Zarhin group 与 FFT 利用 metrics、TR relative volume 或 CM standard–dual pairings 得 HC。最高权按列装载 exterior carriers，width≤Hodge-level/2；Galois rationality 使各 embeddings 的宽度取 maximum，ordinary HC algebraizes quotient map，return-support calculation 得 GHC。

构造 abelian-surface double covers X，resolution quotient Y 给 rank16 anti-invariant lattice V，并剥去8条代数 −4 directions 得 rank8 U。用 determinant/local Hasse invariants 证明 U 在 Y-form 下≃V_P；resolved pullback 到 X 的 form 乘2。theta/logarithmic deformation 与 rank3 tangency pencil、非零 residue pairing4 得六维 period map 满秩。

Gauss fibers 的4个 opposite pairs 上建 coherent half sums（assignment torsor 的局部 monodromy 固定点使其平凡）；排除所有 signed constant relations。两 parity curves addition 总 degree8，4条分支各 multiplicity≥2 穷尽 degree，F*D=2E。分开因子 étale covers 消除 remaining double-cover character，得 product of curves dominates X 与 U_X 的代数 injection。

record.claim_as_stated: The source asserts that every nonempty connected open subset G of the Riemann sphere is conformally equivalent to a circle domain, with no countability, regularity, or separation assumption on its complementary components. Its stronger retained-test theorem preserves an arbitrary countable well-ordered compatible list, exactly on exhausting compact cores, with vanishing total added Dirichlet energy and vanishing counting-l2 positive-excess boundary oscillations, and supplies a countable persistent extension all of whose diagonal finite-transfer limits have circle-domain image. A corollary, using Luo–Wu, realizes every orientable complete genus-zero curvature -1 surface as the intrinsic boundary of a hyperbolic convex hull of a compact circle-type ideal set; it claims neither uniqueness nor the general curvature >=-1 realization problem.
proof_architecture: Collapse each complementary component to obtain a topological sphere X and compact totally disconnected dust B. Smooth dust-disk covers give nested physical compact cores. Coordinates have finite Dirichlet energy, counting-l2 band budgets and possibly one exact additive period; compatibility(P) excludes free dust contacts of later levels with nondegenerate continua in generic earlier finite level unions.

For finitely many tests, independently shifted fine staircases preserve periods and agree with originals on a core. Their pairwise wedge integrals have small expectation. The expected number J of terminal grid collisions satisfies h^2 E J -> 0 by l2 dominated convergence. Compatibility permits the remaining dust to be covered by filling disks whose collars have at most one active coordinate. Fill there with differential rank <=1.

Choose A=sum du_i* tensor du_i* and regularize g_tau=A+tau g_0 outside the core. The summed energy density tends to 2 sqrt(det A), bounded by twice the sum of pairwise wedge magnitudes by Cauchy–Binet; rank-one filling regions contribute zero in the limit. Interpolate in a thin collar to retain the original metric near the core. Finite uniformization and exterior area-theorem bounds yield normalized limits and one complementary continuum K_b(f) for each dust label, with each followed round disk D_b contained in K_b(f).

Build compatible barriers from lower bounds on repeated-visit transboundary path costs. Tags preserve paths that run in earlier level sets; residual dust incidences obey constraints against earlier path laws and levels after finite deletions. Collar splicing and shrinking-jump removal retain cost lower bounds. A clipped chain distance has pointwise band widths <=4m and W^{1,2} control; shrinking positive smoothing preserves bands and free traces. A null-image criterion proves compatibility.

If no small barrier exists, pointwise modulus duality yields a law with L2 mean arclength density, l2 expected visit counts on prescribed countable sets, and absolutely continuous tag-tuple laws. Weighted tag slots can be moved later to make an auxiliary tuple cost arbitrarily small. Uniform bounds for every countable subset and atomless dust measure are fused into one whole-dust l2 hit-probability bound through finite separated-point tests, nonsmall closed sets, joint upper semicontinuity, and nested robust mixtures.

The residual/tag incidence constraints eliminate diffuse intersections of independent laws. Four paths with alternating collar starts must cross, while localized L2 occupations and l2 hit tails make their intersection probability small. Hence at most countably many endpoints lack small barriers. A maximal countable persistent barrier selection, followed by a parallel-line payment estimate, collapses every unmarked K_b to a point.

For a marked end, an unavailable local barrier gives a compact simple-arc law deep near that end. Average the integer indices of lifted rays to obtain a period-one coordinate with small energy and nonsingular bands. Its boundary derivative is the positive start distribution of total mass one. A putative protrusion away from D_b forces a fixed positive boundary integral, but a Stokes estimate bounds it by small energy and nonsingular l2 oscillations. Each test excludes an open neighborhood of one bad pair (f,D_b). Second countability permits countably many compatible persistent exclusions covering all bad pairs, so D_b=K_b. Retained original tests survive the selections and final finite transfers.

construction_ideas.idea: Separate a rigid core from a flexible completion, and reduce the completion to rank one before optimizing a quadratic cost.
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: A finite compatible coordinate family on a two-dimensional conformal domain has finite energies and counting-l2 band budgets. The original metric and coordinate values must be retained only near an exhausting core; outside that core a new smooth conformal structure may be chosen. Compatibility supplies filling collars with at most one nonconstant staircase coordinate.
construction_ideas.mechanism: Independent staircase shifts control pairwise wedge expectation and make h sqrt(J) small. Filling regions have rank(A)<=1 for A=sum du_i tensor du_i. With g_tau=A+tau g_0 the summed energy tends to 2 sqrt(det A)=2 sqrt(sum_{i<j}|du_i wedge du_j|^2). Thus near rank-one structure, rather than the individual derivative sizes in the original metric, controls the optimized quadratic cost. Core agreement is recovered by thin-collar interpolation.
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: Speculative: in a determinant construction, first freeze a witness block or common-basis minor and alter only auxiliary columns/rows outside it. Try to arrange low rank or low pairwise exterior products in the auxiliary region before bounding a quadratic occupancy cost. The Cauchy–Binet identity suggests investigating whether an occupancy relaxation can be expressed through exterior products while the nonzero witness remains fixed.
construction_ideas.missing_step: The source is specific to two-dimensional flexible metrics. Q(Z) row-transversals and integer determinants have a fixed coefficient geometry, and a metric change does not preserve an integer-height estimate. One must exhibit an allowed discrete operation preserving the chosen minor and the BA lower bound, with a proved effect on actual column cost; no such operation follows from this paper.

construction_ideas.idea: Charge every visit with multiplicity, but keep hit probabilities and expected visit counts as separate invariants.
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: Allowed paths have finite domain-part length, density g in L2 and nonnegative counting-l2 boundary toll m. A toll is charged at every parameter time, not merely at each distinct point. Cutting/concatenation is permitted only with countably many new junction/limit times and finite resulting domain-part length. Endpoint toll omissions are explicitly recorded.
construction_ideas.mechanism: Repeated-visit cost is additive under disjoint time decomposition; collar splicing and shrinking-jump removal pay exactly one toll at each merged junction without duplicating cut tolls. In laws, mean counts n_mu are controlled on specified countable sets for products such as sum m_xi n_mu, whereas hit probabilities m_mu are controlled on the whole dust for intersection bounds. The proof never substitutes a distinct-hit bound for a multiplicity bound.
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: Speculative: annotate each row/column or common-basis operation with its occurrence count, and distinguish support occupancy from total multiplicity before applying an l2/Cauchy–Schwarz estimate. This may expose where a row-transversal argument pays a column several times and where a quadratic occupancy sum is actually required. A decomposition that counts junctions once could prevent accidental loss in determinant height accounting.
construction_ideas.missing_step: There is no determinant or matroid statement here. A path-time charge is linear; the project's quadratic occupancy penalty must be derived from an explicit discrete count vector and cannot be inferred from the law's l2 hit norm. The countability/finite-length hypotheses are indispensable for the source concatenation theorem.

source_anchors.label: Positive laws: hit probabilities versus expected visit counts

construction_ideas.idea: Turn separate countable feasibility tests into one common object by requiring robust neighborhood bounds before every later mixture.
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: A Borel family M of laws is closed under all Borel probability mixtures. It admits a Polish topology with the same Borel sets, and m_z(s) is jointly upper semicontinuous on M times compact metric B. For every countable D and finite atomless lambda, some law has ||m_z|D||_2<=C0 and integral m_z d lambda=0, uniformly in D and lambda.
construction_ideas.mechanism: The failures of prescribed tests form a sigma-ideal. Within a closed nonsmall set, remove basis-open small pieces. On finite r-separated configurations, minimax produces a finite mixture meeting all dual weighted l2 tests. Joint upper semicontinuity makes that estimate hold for every simultaneous choice in small closed child neighborhoods. Nested finite branching with shrinking diameters produces a mixture of branch limits that retains every earlier neighborhood estimate. Sending r to zero controls every finite subset of B and hence counting-l2(B).
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: Speculative: this is a precise warning against proving each rank/cost constraint using a different basis and then declaring a common basis exists. For a common-basis search one could first ask whether a convex family of candidate distributions has uniform tests and a topology making their feasibility robust, then maintain all old finite constraints under later choices. Even a finite analogue may help separate a fractional common distribution from an actual witness.
construction_ideas.missing_step: The law output is a mixture, not a deterministic integral basis or row-transversal. Full rank is not convex under averaging matrices, and a determinant may cancel. To use it, one needs either distributions on already valid common bases plus an integral rounding theorem preserving the quadratic cost, or another noncancellation argument. Countable tests alone are insufficient without the stated atomless tests, mixture closure, and joint upper semicontinuity.

construction_ideas.idea: Preserve an existing budget through positive-excess bounds, and make every new obstruction test survive all later extensions.
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: Each fixed coordinate has a counting-l2 band budget a_i; every finite transfer has distinct terminal indices and positive-excess error ||[A_i-a_i]_+||_2<epsilon. Original coordinates and periods are retained exactly on exhausting cores. Compatibility is formulated through finite earlier sublists, so flags may grow and countable limit unions preserve it. Bad limiting pairs live in a second-countable parameter space and admit local exclusion by one fixed appended test.
construction_ideas.mechanism: Minkowski gives ||A_i||_2<=||a_i||_2+epsilon without summing the old budget again at every stage. Fixed tests are eventually present in all finite sublists, even when the well-order exceeds omega. Their contradiction uses fixed compact source sets and vanishing transfer errors, so later list extensions cannot invalidate an earlier exclusion. Each strict open enlargement consumes a new countable-basis element, giving a countable selection covering all bad pairs.
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: Speculative: retain a verified nonzero minor or rank certificate exactly, record only incremental positive cost excess, and require later row/column additions to preserve that certificate. For a compact normalized family of possible counterexamples, local robust determinant/cost contradictions could potentially be organized into a persistent finite or countable test family. This highlights the quantifier gap between a witness depending on each test and one construction surviving every test.
construction_ideas.missing_step: A nonzero polynomial minor is an open condition after evaluation, but fixed-height integer points need not form a compact parameter family and countable selection is not a finite determinant construction. One must supply a discrete persistence lemma, quantitative nonvanishing margin and height control. Positive-excess estimates cannot replace a missing lower bound for the chosen integer determinant.

construction_ideas.idea: Build the lower and upper bounds from the same fixed normalized functional, isolating a unit topological charge from all small costs.
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: A compact family of simple arcs runs from a smooth collar to one dust end. The mean occupation has L2 density, nonsingular hit probabilities have counting-l2 norm, and prior-level intersections are integrable with free contacts excluded. Averaging lifted integer ray indices yields a continuous period-one coordinate with a positive boundary derivative measure of total mass one; smoothing preserves period and bands.
construction_ideas.mechanism: Gate the arc starts a distance d0>0 from a candidate round disk. The same boundary integral of dist(f(.),D) du is >=d0 before smoothing, remains >d0/2 nearby, and is <=sqrt(pi)L||du||_2+2pi L||a off singularity||_2 under Stokes. Deep localization makes the upper bound <d0/4. The distinguished singularity has budget and period one but disappears from the upper-bound error because dist(.,D)=0 on its disk.
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: Speculative: the determinant project likewise needs upper and lower estimates for the identical integer object. Seek a normalized discrete charge or cofactor pairing equal to a fixed nonzero integer, and arrange for the expensive distinguished part to be annihilated by the test functional, leaving only small error contributions. This is a construction pattern for targeting a contradiction, not an arithmetic conclusion about pi.
construction_ideas.missing_step: The source's unit charge is winding number and its cancellation is a distance function vanishing on one disk. There is no provided integer matrix, BA estimate, or arithmetic analogue cancelling a high-cost column. Any proposed cofactor functional must be proved integral, nonzero, and compatible with the actual coefficient-height and occupancy accounting.

limits: This is a complete first reading of the pinned source, not independent verification of the asserted solution to Koebe's conjecture. No external cited proof was checked and no PDF compilation or page-by-page PDF comparison was performed.

The source explicitly permits changing the conformal structure outside the retained cores. It does not establish convergence for arbitrary original-domain exhaustions merely from finite uniformization.

Finite transfers preserve arbitrarily selected finite ordered sublists; they are not required to be finite initial segments of a countable ordinal. Later compatibility/flag extensions preserve fixed tests, but compatibility(P) is a genuine hypothesis, not automatic for arbitrary appended functions.

The fusion output controls whole-dust hit probabilities, while mean visit counts are controlled only on designated countable sets. Confusing these conclusions would lose the residual-intersection estimates.

The hyperbolic corollary assumes curvature identically -1, includes a metric-double convention for planar hulls, and states neither uniqueness nor a prescribed ideal-boundary extension. General curvature at least -1 is explicitly left separate.

No result here proves Q(Z) row rank, common integral bases, an integer determinant lower/upper contradiction, or the needed arithmetic height versus quadratic-occupancy balance. All proposed transfers are speculative and have explicit missing steps.

record.claim_as_stated: 稿件主张：每个 n≥1 的一般凸体 K⊂R^n 都满足 |K| |(K-s(K))°|≥(n+1)^(n+1)/(n!)²，等号当且仅当 K 为单纯形；任意内部中心的对应乘积也有同一下界。无中心对称/边界光滑假设。另由引用的全维几何到函数蕴涵得任意proper l.s.c.凸势φ、0<∫e^-φ<∞时(∫e^-φ)(∫e^-φ*)≥e^n，并给出sharp例，但未分类全部函数等号。对两full-dimensional、essentially continuous的log-concave概率密度，所引等价给H(η1)+H(η2)≤-3n+T(ν1,ν2)。这里记录作者原文主张，不据首读认证成立。

联立坐标变换e^Q与covariance feedback。对Cbar=E mathsfC(L)、Kbar=E mathsfK(L)，以Tnew=(-Cbar−sqrt(Cbar²−4λKbar))/(2λ)更新；scalar bounds给spectral box与discriminant gap，Q球的uniform inward估计配合Brouwer得到EA=0及λT²+Cbar∘T+Kbar=0，全程不假定commutation。
将Π_C、Π_D按正weights在层上积分，先截断与Gaussian平滑证明injectivity及log determinant integrability，再换元/Jensen。log-Jacobian surplus以非嵌套正kernel N/8保留；profile differential identities把成本整理成log Laplace product/m≥−mathcalE。

Gaussian inverse-generator covariance与两层scalar kernel比较给δ[l]、δ[l²]的精确恒等式；对d=F−|u|²且F=c+2kq组合，分出linear-field、Hermite余项和spectral threshold defects。构造β≥0并保留strict layer remainder，奇偶degree gap与weighted PSD blocks控制余项，不要求P_z nested。

record.title: A Direct Proof of Optimal Max-Cut Hardness

source_byte_audit.terminal_LF_handling: apply_patch terminal LF stripped only when removal exactly matched pinned Git blob SHA

sections_read: Introduction and exact weighted/unweighted hardness statements
Affine-row labels, both Fourier conventions, cutoff Majority Is Stablest, affine-game quantifiers
Tree code, complementary traversals and exact dictator correlation
Max-Cut test, completeness and odd/even stability identity
Row symmetries, unsplit projection telescoping and free-shift coordinates
Full vector-valued affine hashing proof with two truncations and fourth moment
All four dimension-independent extraction steps
Full hidden-coordinate decoding, unsmoothing, total variation planting, restriction mass and both endpoint strategies
Parameter ordering, effective rational weighted construction and final ratio gap
Appendix A: affine folded game, validity conditioning, completed tables, invariant lists, quotient-list decoder, soundness/completeness quantifiers and effectivity
Appendix B: deterministic finite-field rectangle construction converting weights and loops to simple unweighted graphs
Included complementary-traversal TikZ figure and complete references
record.claim_as_stated: For every fixed alpha with alpha_GW < alpha <=1, approximating Max-Cut within alpha is NP-hard even for simple unweighted graphs. More precisely, for fixed rational 0<t<1 and 0<epsilon<(t-B(t))/4, B(t)=2 arcsin(t)/pi, distinguishing rational-edge-distribution graphs with value >=(1+t)/2-epsilon from value <=(1+B(t))/2+epsilon is NP-hard. The claimed result is unconditional; Unique Games is historical context, while the argument uses the published imperfect-completeness 2-to-1 game construction and Majority Is Stablest.
proof_architecture: Derive a source game with surjective binary affine projections of fiber size two and quantifier order forall soundness b, exists alphabet n(b), forall completeness error a. Appendix A repairs validity sampling by conditioning, completes linear tables, proves an invariant-list statement respecting the equation span, and uses tagged quotient lists to keep the second-player loss independent of the repetition ambient dimension.

Represent each source label by a long-code dictator generated by a 2s-ary tree. Gate monomials select one child in every pair; the random slice exploration selects both children of one pair. Their exact-one intersection makes every monomial acquire precisely one t factor. Row smoothing gives correlation t r^(2d), d=s^m.

For an arbitrary cut, split even and odd parts. After conditional edge averaging and row noise, the odd part is balanced on the selected slice tables. The cut equals one half plus half odd stability minus half even stability; exceeding the soundness threshold therefore exceeds the Gaussian B(t) threshold.

Majority Is Stablest supplies a low-degree influential entry. Word-preserving row symmetries impose a common child-pair Fourier sum; smoothing and depth averaging make the local unsplit projection cheap. Gate parity forces the odd common sum to be an actual evaluation label. Free generator shifts turn coefficients into translated table arrays.

A Hilbert-vector affine hashing lemma, proved by Fourier inversion, two truncations, pair/triple independence and a fourth-moment common-character identity, shows diffuse label masses cannot cause a large maximum entry influence. This yields a label with conditional mass >=theta on an event of probability >=p*, independent of alphabet dimension.

Remove smoothing by convexity. Plant zero coefficient blocks in a uniform hidden product coordinate, using the binomial density Z/(Tp0) to bound total variation. That coordinate permits the left endpoint to lift the fixed context without seeing the unknown projection. Only 2s free shifts cross a codimension-one restriction, at mass loss 2^(2s); randomized compatible labelers yield source value >=2^(-2s)p*theta/2.

Choose parameters (t,epsilon,mu) then (s,m,p*,theta), then b, n, T, and a. The dimension-free loss permits this noncircular order. Enumerate the constant word-generation spaces for an explicit rational graph. A finite-field dot-product graph approximates every intercluster rectangle and hence every cut; deleting loops on the original scale and converting weights gives the simple-unweighted result.

construction_ideas.idea: Complementary traversals can force every surviving monomial to meet a chosen test exactly once.
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: A rooted tree with s pairs of children per gate; each monomial uses one child in every pair, while the slice traversal follows both children of one pair. The gate Walsh expansion must preserve this support rule at every reached node.
construction_ideas.mechanism: Induct from the root: the shared part is exactly one child at each step, so at every slice depth there is exactly one shared gate. Correlation or sign change applied at the slice therefore gives one scalar factor on every monomial rather than a factor depending on occupancy.
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: When designing selected-row common bases or determinant expansions, seek paired support choices whose transversals meet every surviving permutation in a fixed number of positions. A single controlled entry factor could then be inserted without the usual uncontrolled multiplicity.
construction_ideas.missing_step: The source is a Boolean tree, not a matrix determinant. One must construct actual row/column supports, prove the desired common-basis/noncancellation statement over Q(Z), and account for integer heights. Exact-one intersection alone does not imply any determinant is nonzero.

construction_ideas.idea: Use weighted growth surplus, rather than counting local bad events independently.
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: Fourier indices satisfy q_v=q_(g0)+q_(g1) for every pair. N_j counts nonzero node indices; a split failure at depth j creates surplus nonzero children. The slice inclusion probability is s^(-j), and smoothing weights are r^(2|C|) with r=1-mu/d.
construction_ideas.mechanism: B_j <= N_(j+1)-sN_j telescopes after multiplication by s^(-j). The terminal count is |C|, and x exp(-2mu x)<=1/(2e mu) converts its weighted contribution into s/(2e m mu). No union bound proportional to all tree nodes is needed.
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: For quadratic occupancy or column-height budgets, try a scale-weighted surplus identity in which a local bad signature forces additional future support or rank. Telescoping may charge each obstruction to terminal support only once.
construction_ideas.missing_step: Needs a genuine monotone branching/rank surplus for the target matrix family; cancellations in determinant or Q(Z) rank do not automatically satisfy this count recurrence.

construction_ideas.idea: Dimension-free fourth-moment hashing turns diffuse coefficient mass into a bound on the worst local concentration.
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: c(q,z) belongs to a real Hilbert space, q ranges over H*, z over F_2^s; independent uniform affine shifts L,J_1,...,J_s; w_q=sum_z||c(q,z)||^2 and max_q w_q<=gamma M. Constants depend on desired zeta alone, not dimension H or the Hilbert space.
construction_ideas.mechanism: Fourier inversion gives samples A_p(L+sum p_g J_g). Two truncations control large m_p and large pointwise A_p. In the nondegenerate fourth moment character orthogonality forces all four q equal, giving sum_q(w_q)^2. Degenerate p configurations cost O(2^(-s)).
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: A possible interface to quadratic occupancy is to represent crowded row/column signatures by Hilbert-vector coefficient masses, then bound the maximum hash-bin concentration through a collision square-sum instead of paying alphabet size. This could preserve a height budget while selecting a useful signature.
construction_ideas.missing_step: Target arithmetic coefficients need a valid character action and vector norm, with actual independent shifts; no theorem here controls integer determinant cancellation or supplies a Q(Z)-basis. Translating occupancy into w_q is an unproved design task.

construction_ideas.idea: Localize the comparison to finitely many free coordinates before crossing an unknown quotient.
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: An affine two-to-one projection induces codimension-one row-space inclusion; the context is independent of the hidden marked coordinate because all its linear coefficients there vanish. Only 2s free shifts remain; their Fourier support has a common pair sum. The mark is hidden among T independent candidate coordinates.
construction_ideas.mechanism: Restriction adds at most 2^(2s) Fourier coefficients per index. Cauchy–Schwarz then costs 2^(2s), independent of the full alphabet dimension. Planting has density Z/(Tp0) and TV <=(1/2)sqrt((1-p0)/(Tp0)).
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: For selected-row common bases, factor the ambient context from a bounded local block before making a restriction or quotient comparison. A loss depending on the active block rather than total symbolic dimension may avoid circular choices between rank, height and source parameters.
construction_ideas.missing_step: Requires a concrete locally free block and an applicable restriction identity. Planting increases product size enormously and has no immediate integer-height analogue; the target still needs a same-determinant nonvanishing/upper-bound argument.

limits: Reading is not independent validation of the claimed unconditional Max-Cut threshold. In particular, the affine-game derivation invokes substantial external Grassmann agreement, covering and list theorems; their exact hypotheses and the revised quotient-list adaptation were read as stated but not independently verified against those publications.
Full cached source closure includes both appendices, the included figure and bibliography. No PDF compilation or page-by-page PDF comparison was performed.

The target pi BA/nonBA problem receives construction interfaces only. None of these mechanisms supplies a nonzero integer determinant of absolute value less than one, a proof of symbolic rank over Q(Z), a selected-row common basis, or a quantitative height inequality.
The large constants are allowed to be fixed with the approximation gap; polynomial-time statements are asymptotic in the source instance, not practical constructions.

No independent theorem validation is claimed.

sections_read: README、主文件、abstract及所有输入闭包

record.claim_as_stated: 对任意实多项式F、deg F≤5，经典Liénard系统ẋ=y−F(x), ẏ=−x在整个平面至多有两个几何不同的孤立周期轨道；无奇偶、系数符号、振幅、双曲性或重数假设。上界可达，因此该类精确最大值为二；这是primitive F的五次情形，等价阻尼F′至多四次且回复力严格为x。
proof_architecture: 去掉F(0)，必要时作反射与时间反转使五次系数非负。在两半平面以u=x²/2、y为坐标，得到u_y=φ±(u)−y；两个profile共享偶系数二次部分，奇系数部分符号相反。
证明任意正基高h、峰值t的arch有唯一两个横截端点；半宽r全局严格参数化峰值，|M|<r、|M_r|<1。以逆支方程dy/du=1/(φ(u)−y)把全部宽导数延续到可能非光滑的u=0。周期轨道与共同开宽区间上Δ=M+−M−的根双射，孤立性也完全对应。
对每个(r,M,M_r)建立唯一有限二次profile λu+κu²/2拟合。先在固定κ下拟合M，再用曲率比较证明条件宽导数对κ的导数G/P>0，并用单调收敛及两段平均斜率证明κ→±∞时覆盖整个(−1,1)。由P,Q,R,S,G>0得到联合光滑全局逆。
从精确变分得小宽拟合κ=φ″+(2/7)φ‴r²+O(r³)、λ=φ′−φ‴r⁴/35+O(r⁵)，并推导Pλ_r+Qκ_r=0，Dκ=−(R/G)(λ−φ′)，Dλ−κ=(S/G)(λ−φ′)。
核心模型不等式(R/G)_r≤0通过W=RS_r−SR_r≥0。对κ>0，用Riccati线性化的正V及一个跨越y=0的正规2×2系统构造两端共同projective标签；Schwarzian链式法则、显式端点代数与三个(m,n,ℓ)情形证明W任何零处向外导数严格正；小宽W>0排除首零。反射处理κ<0，连续性处理κ=0。
将模型不等式和正核比较输运到一般profile：φ‴>0⇒λ<φ′且κ_r>0；((φ′−d)/u)′>0⇒λ−hκ<d。另证拟合κ位于实际曲率范围内。
令p=e√u+cu^(3/2)+au^(5/2)、a≥0。e,c均非负时无孤立环；e≥0,c<0时q=κ+−κ−非减，Δ′=AΔ+Bq、B>0，正积分因子后至多两个孤立根；其余两情形给曲率或严格斜率间隙，所有根Δ′>0故至多一根。显式Fε=ε(4x−20x³/3+8x⁵/5)的精确能量商在ε=0的s=1,2有两个单根，由隐函数定理产生内排斥、外吸引两条双曲环。

construction_ideas.idea: 把约束拟合拆成条件一维拟合；用Schur补确定剩余方向的符号与非退化。
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: 模型H(λ,κ,r)全局光滑；固定r>0有H_λ=P>0，G=H_λH_{κr}−H_κH_{λr}>0；固定M条件下κ的响应达到完整目标范围。
construction_ideas.mechanism: 先解H=M得到λ*(r,M,κ)，再有∂κ(H_r|H=M)=S−RQ/P=G/P>0。局部Jacobian非零不足以给全局拟合，稿件另证properness/全范围才取得全局逆。
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: 对Q(Z)的候选行选择或加权参数构造，可先固定一个可控moment/归一化，研究剩余方向的条件rank或cost响应；Schur补把同一约束上的独立性与剩余响应分开。更广泛适用于受约束逆问题和两参数校准。
construction_ideas.missing_step: Q(Z)的row-transversal集合是离散的，未给出这样的光滑H或符号固定的2×2minor。即使形式上有Schur补，仍须证明实际存活minor、全局可达及整数高度成本；不能由Jacobian存在推最终π determinant非零。

construction_ideas.idea: 用正积分因子把复杂匹配差的零点计数化为一个单调障碍函数的符号变化。

record.title: A nine-dimensional counterexample to Borsuk's covering assertion
sections_read: README、main 与 preamble；Introduction 的主定理、历史和证明路线
From diameter covers to projective maps：projector Frobenius 距离、严格间隙开覆盖、smooth admissible map、support complex
An extension to symmetric matrices：PSD 积分、子空间相容性、positive/negative spectral support 与 odd norm-sphere map

record.claim_as_stated: X={uu^T: u∈R^4, ||u||=1} 位于 trace-one symmetric 4×4 矩阵的九维 Euclidean affine space，在 Frobenius metric 中 diameter=√2，不能由十个 diameter 严格小于 √2 的子集覆盖。因此 Borsuk 覆盖断言在维数九失败；另构造每个 d≥9 的紧反例。文章不确定最小失败维数或 b(X) 的精确值，见证为完整 RP^3 projector image。
proof_architecture: ||P_x-P_y||_F²=2−2<u,v>² 将直径对精确等同正交线。严格小直径使任意覆盖可扩大为仍避正交对的相对开覆盖，再由 partition of unity 产生非负、和为一、正交线 support 不交的 smooth f。

对 PSD Q 定义 E(Q)=k∫||Q^{1/2}u||² f([Q^{1/2}u])dμ；其 coordinate support 恰为 range(Q) 所有线的标签并，sum E=tr Q，且对子空间限制相容。F(A)=E(A+)−E(A−) 无坐标抵消，||F(A)||_1=tr|A|，给 Sym_k trace-norm sphere 到 label ℓ1 sphere 的 odd map。
Borsuk–Ulam/odd degree 给 m≥N_k=k(k+1)/2；m=N_k 时 odd self-map degree 为一 mod2、surjective，并逼出 support complex 全部边。

对任意最大 support I，正交补标签下界先给 |I|≤k。规则值 level set L 位于一个 affine projective chart；在 x⊥ 的 symmetric sphere bundle 上比较局部 preimage count 与 F，得到奇数。chart trivialization 使其 projective bundle double-cover class 纯来自 fiber，若 dim L>0 顶维 pullback 消失，degree 为零，矛盾。因此所有 facets 大小 k，局部奇数系数给 facets 总和为 F2 cycle。
k=3,m=6 时互补 triples 不能同时出现；全部边且每边正偶数 incidence 逼出恰十个三角形、每边恰两次；每点 link 为五圈，任何五标签唯一决定系统，任何两点的三标签受限 links 不同。
k=4,m=10 时每个 tetrahedron complement 恰带六标签系统。相邻 tetrahedron 的交换 transport 若有三个共同 triangle 延拓会产生不允许的 transposition；故每 triangle 恰两个延拓。长 edge-link 路径同样产生受限 links 相等矛盾，故 links 仅三圈/四圈。

相邻 facet 的 partner 交换保持 blocks，枚举每 block 恰略一元素的 facets；任意 facet 必在某 block 占至少二点。计数剩余标签迫使 blocks 大小 3,2,2、外部 R 大小三；六标签系统的一条 R-R edge 强迫涉及二元素 block 的 triangle，但该 triangle 仅能有一个 tetrahedral 延拓，与恰两次矛盾。最后用 Gram I_s+(1/4)11^T 添加彼此及距原集合均为 √2 的点推广。

construction_ideas.idea: 由非负坐标与正交 support 分离构造不发生抵消的 signed matrix extension。
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: V=R^k,k≥2；smooth f:P(V)→R^m 满足 f_i≥0、Σf_i=1，且 x⊥y⇒S(x)∩S(y)=∅。PSD 延拓必须用 k 倍 rotation-invariant sphere probability integral；对 symmetric A 的 A+、A− spectral ranges 正交。
construction_ideas.mechanism: 积分保 trace、精确保 range 上所有标签的并，并对子空间限制相容。两个正锥输出 supports 不交，因此 subtraction 的 ℓ1 norm 恰为 tr|A|，不是仅有上界；其 nonzero coordinates 还检测输入 nonsingularity。
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: 对 pi 项目可尝试把 candidate row-transversal 的 incidence/signature 数据嵌入 PSD/Gram lifting，让 quadratic occupancy cost 变成 trace/Frobenius quantity，并寻求按 orthogonal blocks 分解后没有 cancellation 的量。该构造也提示对 Q(Z) 的形式秩，先证明精确 support 性质再取范数估计。
construction_ideas.missing_step: pi 行/列 supports 尚未给满足正交分离的 smooth partition；trace norm identity 不能推出一个指定 integer determinant 非零，Gram lifting 还可能平方 height 或增维。需要独立证明所构造 determinant 与上下界使用的是同一整数。

construction_ideas.idea: 阈值处把全局奇偶 obstruction 提升成每个 maximal support 的纯度及 cycle 系数。
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: k≥3、m=N_k，并有上述 smooth admissible map。对 maximal I，U_I 全部 supports 恰为 I，且落在由某 witness x0 定义的 affine chart；其 orthogonal-complement bundle 在该 chart 平凡。取 f_I 的规则值以及负 orthant 的规则值，局部 source/target 维数均须相等。
construction_ideas.mechanism: F 的 odd mod2 degree 给 sphere-bundle map 的奇 preimage count；若 level set L 正维，quotient map 拉回 cover class 为 pr_2*u，故顶维 cohomology 为零，得偶 count 矛盾。dim L=0 时每 fiber odd degree 给每 facet 系数一，从而 facets 总和为 cycle。
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: 这是由全局存在性结构推出所有局部候选的强限制的例子；若 Q(Z) 存活 transversals 能成为某个有全局 invariant 的 support complex，可尝试从 equality case 推出统一 occupancy/capacity，而不用逐一枚举。较远的界面是把秩临界情形转为边界闭合约束。
construction_ideas.missing_step: 目前没有与 pi 候选簇对应的 compact manifold、odd map 或 cover class。抽象组合 supports 本身不满足纯度和 cycle 结论，不能把 triangulation vertex bounds 直接套用。

construction_ideas.idea: 用相邻候选之间的唯一局部恢复与 exchange holonomy 排除高 multiplicity，并提取不变 blocks。
construction_ideas.precise_hypotheses: 十标签纯三维 complex；facets 的和是 F2 cycle；每 facet complement 的六标签 triangle system 满足互补 triples 恰选一、每 pair 恰两 triangles。五标签 restriction 唯一决定系统，且任意 transposition 不保持系统，并有三标签受限 links 的区分性质。
construction_ideas.mechanism: 沿 facet exchanges transport 六标签系统；三 facet 共 triangle 的闭路产生 transposition，故三角形只能恰两延拓。五点 edge-link 路径产生两个受限 links 相等，故 links 仅三圈/四圈。由此 partner update 保持 blocks，可实现所有每 block 略一元素的 facets，最终 occupancy 强迫矛盾。
construction_ideas.possible_bridge: 对 row-transversals 可定义局部 exchange 图和 signature transport，检查小 exchange 闭路是否迫使一个不允许的 permutation；若成立，可把 surviving minors 的候选分成稳定 blocks，再用每列 quadratic occupancy 的块下界计成本。这一界面不依赖与原定理主题接近。
construction_ideas.missing_step: 必须先证明五标签式的唯一恢复、forbidden automorphism 及 exchange 保存真实 Q(Z) rank；普通 matroid basis exchanges 没有这些刚性。其所得 block cost 也尚不足以构成 integer determinant 的非零/小于一矛盾。

record.title: Lech's multiplicity conjecture
